audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Divine kingship, storm imagery, idols, elohim/gods, Zion, and justice.

verses.restored: YHWH reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

familiar.text: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

modern.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

familiar.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

modern.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.

original.text: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ

verses.restored: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

familiar.text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

modern.text: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

original.text: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו

verses.restored: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

familiar.text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

modern.text: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.

original.text: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The hills melted like wax at the presence of YHWH, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

familiar.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

modern.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

original.text: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

familiar.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

modern.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.

original.text: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ

verses.restored: Let all who serve an image be put to shame, those who boast in idols; bow before him, all you gods [elohim].

familiar.text: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

notes.title: Elohim in Psalm 97
notes.body: The final term elohim can be understood as gods/divine beings. Ancient religious polemic should not be converted into permission to persecute people of other religions or spiritual traditions.

modern.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!

original.text: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ כָּל עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֝וֹ כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O YHWH.

familiar.text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

modern.text: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.

original.text: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: For thou, YHWH, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

familiar.text: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

modern.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Ye that love YHWH, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

familiar.text: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

modern.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

original.text: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם

verses.restored: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

familiar.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

modern.text: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.

original.text: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה

verses.restored: Rejoice in YHWH, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

familiar.text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

modern.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.

original.text: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Ancient idol polemic must not justify persecution of other religions or destruction of modern sacred objects.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
